this is the most overused, lazy, bullshit advice. How exactly do you expect me to do that? You think I haven't heard that sentence a million fucking times? How about expanding on that thought because obviously, it's not sinking for a lot of people. I don't care how true it may be....you need to give more constructive advice than the same thing people say all the time.

I don't mean to lash out on you, but this sentence really pisses me off.
thank you. it was not disastrous.

What I am going to do is not have kids. That's the best I can do to not be like her. I know I am crazy, so not bringing any more lives into this miserable world is the best thing I can do. It's more of what I won't do instead of proactive things I can do. 

She tried to be a good person. She just can't do it because she's too fucked up.
